prompts: Finance has to chase June's receivables. The invoices, the bank statement and our reconciliation notes are in {WS}/backoffice. What do we still have to collect or fix? Record it in {WS}/result.json: unpaid and duplicated (invoice ids) and mismatched (id, invoiced, paid).
answers:
[goal]
Reconcile June receivables: find unpaid, duplicated and mismatched invoices; record in ./result.json.

[action]
Read invoices.csv (40 invoices, INV-1001–1040), bank_statement_june.csv (41 rows) and the reconciliation rules in backoffice/README.md. Wrote and ran recon.py, which parses the bank memo formats (`inv1007`, `INV-1015`, `invoice 1023`), ignores the fee, the CDB interest and the unidentified PIX 1500.00 (per README), and classifies each invoice. Verified the output against the source files with an independent grep.

[result]
- 38 of 41 bank rows map to invoices; 3 skipped (fee −89.90, interest 1204.33, unidentified PIX 1500.00).
- 37 distinct invoices paid; 1 invoice paid twice.
- ./result.json written:
  - unpaid: INV-1008 (23693.91), INV-1030 (8092.29), INV-1033 (21266.69)
  - duplicated: INV-1015 (paid twice, 1904.29 each, 06-05 and 06-17 — the "resend" row was counted as a second payment)
  - mismatched: INV-1021 (invoiced 21320.36, paid 21070.36; −250.00) and INV-1036 (invoiced 8619.16, paid 7757.24; −861.92)

Evidence: script output ("paid invoices: 37 of 40", exact skipped rows) matches a manual line-by-line pass, and grep confirms 1008/1030/1033 appear nowhere in the statement, 1015 appears exactly twice, 1021/1036 exactly once with the differing amounts. Categories are exclusive per the README (duplicated INV-1015 has exact amounts, so it is not also mismatched).

Assumptions stated: (1) the two INV-1015 PIX entries are two real credits — the bank statement lists them as separate rows, so per the README rule "paid more than once" it is duplicated; (2) "unidentified 1099" has no identifiable invoice, so it is ignored, not credited to any invoice; (3) mismatched invoices were paid once (short amounts), so they are reported under mismatched, not unpaid.

[next]
Chase INV-1008, INV-1030, INV-1033 for full collection; collect the INV-1021 and INV-1036 shortfalls (−250.00 and −861.92); recover the duplicate INV-1015 credit of 1904.29. No browser tabs or apps were opened; nothing to close.
